font.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro Display", "Helvetica Neue", system-ui, sans-serif
font.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, monospace
font.numbers: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on every changing number

color.rule: One stage colour + one accent per surface. Accent is for the single most important action or state.

brand.rule: Porcelain is Tweensmith's own identity. It ships as the preset `porcelain` (light and dark) in components/_shared/themes.js, one preset among the others; the default preset stays neutral and flat. Use it only when the product you are building is meant to look like Tweensmith.

motion.rule: Springs for anything the pointer touches; eases only for opacity/colour. Wrap apps in <MotionConfig reducedMotion="user">.

glass.rule: Glass needs something colourful moving behind it, or it is just grey.
